QuestInfo.name: A Season of Admiration
QuestInfo.0: Take a look around the Gonzo Gallery.
QuestInfo.1: Spiegelmann created the Seasonal Series to represent his viewpoint throughout the year. Make sure to give each of them a good click to make him feel like a good artist.
QuestInfo.2: You checked out all of Spiegelmann's painting, like a good friend!

0.0: These paintings all flowed from my skilled hands as if pulled into the world by an unseen force! Each represents an unforgettable event specific to a certain season, so I've named them... the Seasonal Series! Take a look!

yes.0: Feel free to take a closer look at any of my masterpieces with a simple click. Try not to miss any of them! They are a series, with each piece just as important as the last!

no.0: You have no appreciation for the arts!

1.0: So, what do you think? Speechless, right?! Haha! My pieces are as impactful as they are insightful!
